 Medium
 Large
 Print Former IPL chairman and businessman Lalit Modi sent birthday wishes to actress Sushmita Sen as she turned 51. In an Instagram post, he addressed her as his “dear friend”, years after their widely discussed relationship. Lalit posted a black-and-white photo of the two of them along with a warm birthday message for the actress. Lalit Modi wishes Sushmita Sen on her 51st birthday
 In the picture, Sushmita is seen smiling in a black dress, while Lalit wears a white pantsuit. The photo carries the text, “Happy Birthday My Friend.” Sharing it, Modi wrote, “Wishing you a very happy birthday my dearest Friend@sushmitasen47 - keep smiling.” The wish comes almost four years after the two made their relationship public in 2022.  When Lalit Modi called Sushmita Sen his ‘better half’
 For those unaware, the two grabbed headlines in July 2022 when Lalit posted a series of pictures with Sushmita from their holidays in the Maldives and Sardinia. Announcing the relationship, the businessman referred to the actress as his “better half” and said it marked the beginning of a new chapter in his life. Watch Months after suffering a heart attack, Sushmita Sen shares her health update: 'I have been healing beautifully' Lalit Modi clarifies he and Sushmita Sen were not married
 His post also set off speculation that the couple was about to tie the knot. Lalit, however, later clarified that the two were only dating and had not got married. Lalit Modi and Sushmita Sen’s split rumours begin
 Speculation about a breakup between the two began in September 2022, when Lalit swapped his Instagram display picture to remove Sushmita’s photographs and also deleted references to her from his bio. Lalit Modi moves on with Rima Bouri 
 In February 2025, Lalit seemingly moved on, posting a video with his new partner, Rima Bouri. In the caption, he shared that their 25-year-long friendship had finally turned into love. Lalit Modi on why his relationship with Sushmita Sen ended
 Months later, in June 2026, Lalit opened up about his relationship with Sushmita in an interview. Looking back at why things did not work out, he pointed to the distance between them as one of the main reasons for their breakup.
